admission.justification: Realized across serving/paseo/provider_limit_suppressions.py and serving/paseo/provider_limits.py, proven by four unit tests in mcp/tests/test_provider_limit_suppression.py, and required to keep mixed-version v1 readers working while persisting suppression state.

applicability: Every write, periodic recheck, and suppression mutation of provider limits under <home>/agents-remember/.
conditions: provider-limit-suppressions.json (schema ar-provider-limit-suppressions/v1) lives beside provider-limits.json and is updated exclusively by serving.paseo.provider_limits under provider-limits.lock.
provider-limits.json remains strictly ar-provider-limits/v1 with no extra fields so mixed-version extra=forbid readers continue to parse it cleanly.

Existing recordedAt timestamps for unchanged live (reportId, windowId, resetsAt) windows are preserved across usage re-reads, and expired sidecar entries (resetsAt <= now) are pruned in both record_usage_reads and _periodic_update.
Sidecar and provider-limits.json writes commit as an atomic all-or-nothing pair, rolling back the sidecar if the provider-limits.json write fails.
exclusions: A missing sidecar is treated as empty without migrating or rewriting an existing v1 provider-limits.json until the next normal write.
A quiet periodic tick with no expired sidecar entries and no due reports performs no file write.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_provider_limit_suppression.py (21 passed) + .githooks/_gate.sh fast PASS on clean tree 54a3d3198b5f47b34a4987cbadf2c9ca58a20a4d

statement: Per-window recordedAt timestamps and active window-scoped provider-limit suppressions are stored in the sibling sidecar provider-limit-suppressions.json written atomically by serving.paseo.provider_limits under provider-limits.lock, keeping provider-limits.json strictly ar-provider-limits/v1, preserving recordedAt across re-reads, and pruning expired entries during both record_usage_reads and _periodic_update.
title: Sibling sidecar stores recordedAt and suppressions keeping limits file v1
